title.original: Sherlock: Reliable and Efficient Agentic Workflow Execution
title.zh: Sherlock：可靠高效的代理工作流程执行
title.en: Sherlock: Reliable and Efficient Agentic Workflow Execution

inclusion_reason.zh: Sherlock 的节点风险分析、验证器放置、投机执行和回滚检查点构成可复用的可靠 Agent 工作流运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: Sherlock combines node-risk analysis, verifier placement, speculative execution, and rollback checkpoints into a reusable reliable-workflow runtime.

abstract.zh: Sherlock 用反事实分析识别 Agent 工作流中最容易传播错误的节点，只在必要位置附加成本最优验证器。运行时让下游任务与后台验证投机并行，验证失败时回滚到最近的已验证输出。
abstract.en: Sherlock uses counterfactual analysis to identify workflow nodes whose errors are most consequential and attaches cost-optimal verifiers only there. At runtime, downstream work executes speculatively beside background verification and rolls back to the last verified output on failure.

problem.zh: 工作流早期的部分错误会在后续放大，但逐节点使用自省、辩论或 LLM Judge 会带来不可接受的时延和调用成本。
problem.en: Partial errors at early nodes can amplify downstream, but verifying every step with reflection, debate, or LLM judges adds prohibitive latency and cost.

approach.zh: 离线反事实分析估计节点出错对最终结果的影响并选择验证器；在线阶段投机执行验证节点的后继，失败后取消结果并从检查点重放。
approach.en: Offline counterfactual analysis estimates each node's impact and selects a verifier; online execution speculates beyond verification points, discarding work and replaying from a checkpoint when a check fails.

system_design.zh: Sherlock 的规划器生成节点风险与验证器映射，执行器维护已验证检查点、后台验证任务和投机分支；回滚控制器负责撤销失败分支并恢复状态。
system_design.en: A planner produces node-risk and verifier mappings, an executor tracks verified checkpoints, background checks, and speculative branches, and a rollback controller restores state after failed verification.

key_results.zh: 跨基准结果报告 Sherlock 提高工作流准确率，同时以投机执行缩短相对非投机验证的运行时间，并降低相对搜索式方法的验证成本。
key_results.en: Across benchmarks, Sherlock is reported to improve workflow accuracy, reduce runtime relative to non-speculative verification, and lower verification cost versus search-based selection.

limitations.zh: 反事实风险估计可能随模型、提示和工具变化而失效；对外部有副作用的工具无法总是安全回滚，投机工作在高失败率下也会浪费资源。
limitations.en: Counterfactual risk estimates may drift with models, prompts, and tools; external side effects are not always rollback-safe, and speculative work can waste resources when failures are frequent.

workloads: agentic workflow benchmarks with selective verification

notes.zh: 三类基线和准确率/时间/成本结果来自官方摘要；基准、模型、验证器、硬件与平均方式待全文审计。
notes.en: Three baseline classes and accuracy/time/cost results come from the official abstract; benchmarks, models, verifiers, hardware, and averaging await full-text audit.
